Niacinamide

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is one of the most studied and proven actives in skincare. It works by inhibiting melanin transfer to the skin's surface - meaning dark spots, sun damage, and post-acne marks gradually fade with consistent use. But it doesn't stop there: Niacinamide strengthens the skin barrier, reduces pore appearance, and regulates oil production. It's effective across all skin types without irritation, which is why dermatologists recommend it as a foundational ingredient. In our Toner Pads, it's dosed at clinical concentration so every swipe delivers real results - not just a label claim.

Peptides

Peptides are short chains of amino acids that act as messengers to your skin cells. When applied topically, they signal your body to ramp up collagen and elastin production - the two proteins responsible for keeping skin firm, bouncy, and resilient. As we age, collagen production drops roughly 1% per year, leading to fine lines and sagging. Peptides help counteract that decline at the cellular level. Unlike retinol, peptides deliver firming benefits without irritation or sensitivity, making them safe for daily use on all skin types. Our formula uses targeted peptide complexes that penetrate effectively through the toner pad delivery system.

Clinical studies show snail mucin improves skin hydration by up to 25% within hours of application. It's especially effective when paired with exfoliating actives (like in our Toner Pads) because it soothes and replenishes the skin immediately after treatment.

For anyone dealing with redness, sensitivity, or irritation from environmental stress, Centella provides immediate calming relief. It's the reason our Toner Pads can deliver powerful actives like Vitamin C and Niacinamide without causing irritation — Centella balances the formula so your skin gets the benefits without the burn.

Hyaluronic Acid Complex

Not all Hyaluronic Acid is created equal. Most products use a single molecular weight, which only hydrates at one depth. Our Toner Pads use a multi-weight Hyaluronic Acid complex - combining high, medium, and low molecular weights - so moisture is delivered and locked in at every layer of the skin. The larger molecules form a hydrating barrier on the surface, while the smaller molecules penetrate deeper to plump from within. The result is hydration that lasts all day, not just the first hour. Well-hydrated skin also absorbs other actives more effectively, which means every ingredient in the formula works harder.

Alpha-Arbutin

Alpha-Arbutin is one of the most effective and gentlest brightening ingredients available. It works by inhibiting tyrosinase - the enzyme responsible for melanin production - which means it fades existing dark spots, sun damage, and hyperpigmentation while preventing new spots from forming. Unlike hydroquinone (which can cause rebound darkening and irritation), Alpha-Arbutin delivers comparable brightening results with zero sensitization risk. It's safe for all skin tones and types, including sensitive skin. Combined with Niacinamide and Vitamin C in our Toner Pads, it creates a triple-action brightening system that targets discoloration from multiple pathways simultaneously.

Licorice Root Extract

Licorice Root Extract (Glycyrrhiza Glabra) is a powerhouse brightening and anti-inflammatory ingredient backed by decades of dermatological research. Its key active compound — Glabridin — inhibits tyrosinase activity and blocks UV-induced melanin production, making it one of the most effective natural brightening agents available. But unlike many brightening actives, Licorice Root simultaneously calms inflammation and reduces redness, so it treats discoloration without aggravating the skin conditions that cause it. Studies show Glabridin can reduce melanin production by up to 50% at targeted concentrations. It also contains Liquiritin, which disperses existing melanin deposits — meaning it fades the spots you already have, not just the ones forming. In our Toner Pads, Licorice Root Extract works in concert with Alpha-Arbutin, Niacinamide, and Vitamin C to create a multi-pathway brightening system where each ingredient attacks hyperpigmentation through a different mechanism. The result is faster, more visible fading without the irritation or photosensitivity that comes with harsher alternatives like hydroquinone.

NAD+

NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) is the cornerstone of our Anti-Aging Moisturizing Cream. This coenzyme exists in every cell of your body and is essential for energy production, DNA repair, and cellular renewal. By age 50, your NAD+ levels have dropped by nearly half - and your skin shows it: slower healing, loss of firmness, and deepening lines. By delivering NAD+ topically, this cream helps restore the cellular machinery your skin needs to function like it did years ago. Cells turn over faster, produce more collagen, and repair damage more efficiently. This is anti-aging that works at the source - not just the surface.
